## normalizePath() function

Normalize a path by resolving `.` and `..` segments and converting all slashes to forward slashes.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function normalizePath(path: string): string;
```

**Returns:**

## Remarks

- Converts backslashes to forward slashes - Resolves `.` (current directory) and `..` (parent directory) segments - Removes redundant slashes - Preserves trailing slashes on directory paths
